title: 俗世凡尘 第15章 比试上俗世凡尘 第16章 比试中

酒过三巡，建王忽然把酒杯一放，突然朗声道：“这酒宴忒无趣，连个助兴的曲目都没有。”宾客之中马上有人附和道：“是呀，是呀。南宫兄，这大喜之日，有美酒佳肴，岂可无歌舞助兴。”
南宫修尴尬一笑，拱手道：“两位殿下，诸位贵客，敝宗实是简陋，无歌舞可观，还请多多包涵，将就一下。”云隐门不过是个小宗门，家底薄，就连南宫修自家，平日里就过得抠抠搜搜，哪有余钱搞这些花里胡哨的东西。
永乐公主俏脸现出一丝不悦之色，道：“老四，你要干什么，可别再惹事。”
建王哈哈一笑：“姐，你放心，弟弟我怎敢给你添麻烦？”转头对南宫修道：“南宫掌门说笑了，云隐门地处鄙陋，本王岂能不知，怎会让你为难。不过别忘了，咱们白马国崇尚武道，云隐门也是武道宗门，这助兴非得用歌舞的吗？”
有人道：“对呀，再不济让弟子们耍两套剑助助兴也好啊。”
建王嗤之以鼻：“不不不，花拳绣腿有什么好看的。既然是武道宗门，当然是以比武来助兴。你说是吧，南宫掌门？”
南宫修脸露为难之色：“建王殿下千金之躯，而刀剑无眼，恐有个闪失……”
建王摆摆手道：“南宫掌门多虑了，本王的意思，是让你云隐门作为主人，今日来访的各位宾客，主客之间切磋比试。既增进友谊，又能给酒宴助兴，可谓是一举两得。”朝永乐公主眨巴着眼睛：“怎么样，姐，我这主意不错吧？”
永乐公主哼了一声，不置可否。她其实也觉无聊，建王的主意是不错，可不知咋的，她感觉这提议从一向不干正事的建王口中说出来，好像哪里不对。
随后，建王又补充道：“当然，本次比试以年轻弟子为主，所以年龄当有限制，十六岁以上弟子就不参加。另外，既然是比试，那就该有个彩头，本王宣布，获胜一方的参赛者各得上品小灵丹一颗。”
此言一出，瞬间点燃了酒宴上这些年轻人的热情。上品小灵丹，低阶武者服下可以大幅增长灵力，如果用来破境，也大有助益。
抛开上品小灵丹，若能在比试中借机大放异彩，引得皇室垂青，凭借皇室这层关系，也能获得大量好处，在武道上走得更远，自身现所在的宗门也能凭借这层关系，地位水涨船高。
南宫修很是无奈，他何尝不知道建王因为先前之事，故意找云隐门麻烦。今日前来做客的年轻弟子，无一不是各宗门的天之骄子，实力不俗。
而云隐门小宗门，弟子灵力境界普遍都低。南宫月资质还算不错，可惜她是女儿身，堂堂一宗门指望一个女孩子来出头，明显不合适。至于陆多福，他心性和悟性都是最好的，可惜不能修炼……
今日一场惨败注定不可避免。南宫修苦笑道：“如此，在下就不再扫兴了，一切听凭殿下安排。不过，既是切磋，就当点到即止，不可蓄意伤人。”
铁拳门门主史元龙笑道：“南宫兄多虑了，在座的各位贤侄会掌握分寸的，绝不会伤了贵宗弟子。”“就是就是，放心吧，南宫兄的面子还是要给的。”众宾客纷纷道。
居然毫不把云隐门放在眼里，云隐门众弟子心下暗骂。南宫修面无表情，转头对南宫月道：“月儿，这儿没你们的事了，你带多福先退下吧！”
南宫月还未答话，建王抢先开口道：“且慢，南宫掌门。月儿妹妹身为女子，这场比试不参与也行。可是这位陆兄弟，既为男儿身，又是你唯一的弟子，岂能置身事外。”
南宫修心下一凛，这建王肯定因之前的事情在针对陆多福，当下恭恭敬敬地道：“殿下有所不知，多福天生没有灵脉，不能修炼。所以这比试，还是不让他参加了吧？”

满堂宾客大惊，纷纷瞪大了眼睛，像发现什么怪物一样盯着陆多福看，陆多福被看得头皮发麻。建王也是一愣：“没有灵脉，人怎么会没有灵脉。南宫掌门，你会不会搞错了？”
南宫修道：“不敢欺瞒殿下，小徒确实天生绝脉，此事敝宗上下人尽皆知。在下也曾带他遍访名医，但均无任何办法。”
建王向身旁一个护卫道：“甘荣，你看看这小子是不是像南宫掌门说的那样。”那个叫甘荣的护卫修为已到武宗境，灵觉极是敏锐。他当即释放灵觉朝陆多福一扫，平静地道：“殿下，这年轻人确实毫无灵力。”
陆多福松了口气，同时也觉得奇怪。自己明明身负灵力，凭这护卫的厉害，他没道理探不出来。若是他故意隐瞒，那又说不通。难不成自己过去都是错觉，所谓的“大海无量”修成的根本不是灵力？想到这里，陆多福莫名觉得有些慌。
其实陆多福不知道的，他虽然修了灵力，但他层次太低，灵力太弱，不容易被感知出来。
另外还有个更深层次的原因就是，人很难准确评估自己不熟悉的东西。而无脉之息由于其独特的运转方式不为常人所知，所以修习无脉之息的人，不容易被其他武者感应到自己身上的灵力。
这就相当于陆多福天生多了一重保护色，以后随着灵力的累积，他可能会被人看出来身负灵力，但不一定看得准。打个比方，假如陆多福现在是武皇境，那别人一眼看得出来这是个武者，但没法具体看出来他是武皇境几重。
……
建王叹了口气道：“这么说，他确实是个废物了。”他心下不甘，本来这比试主要就是针对陆多福的。他都想好了，一旦陆多福上场，他就安排个修为更高的对手，再暗示一下，让对手狠揍陆多福，至少要把他打残废。
这下没辙了，陆多福没灵力，堂堂皇子，总不能强行让一个不能修炼的废物上去比试吧。
满堂宾客哈哈大笑。“南宫兄，你是怎么想的，怎么收了这么个弟子。”
“不能修炼的废物，哈哈，这种的，我一人打一百个。”
“天生绝脉，老夫闻所未闻……”
南宫月俏脸盛怒，这些人笑话陆多福就等于笑话她，如果有机会，她一定好好教训这些人，好给陆多福出口恶气。

After three rounds of drinking, King Jian suddenly put down the wine glass and said loudly: "This banquet is so boring, there is not even a piece of music to entertain." Someone among the guests immediately echoed: "Yes, yes. Brother Nangong, on this big day, there are fine wines and delicacies, how can there be no singing and dancing to entertain."
Nangong Xiu smiled awkwardly, cupped his hands and said: "Your Highnesses, distinguished guests, our sect is really simple and has no singing and dancing to entertain. Please bear with me and make do with it." Yunyin Sect is just a small sect with a small family background. Even Nangong Xiu's own family has to dig and search on weekdays, so there is no spare money for such fancy things.
Princess Yongle's pretty face showed a hint of displeasure and said: "Fourth, what are you going to do? Don't cause trouble again."
King Jian laughed loudly: "Sister, don't worry, brother, how dare I cause trouble for you?" He turned to Nangong Xiu and said, "Nangong leader is joking. Yunyin Sect is in a humble location. How could I not know this and put you in trouble? But don't forget, our Baima Kingdom advocates martial arts, and Yunyin Sect is also a martial arts sect. Doesn't this have to be done with singing and dancing?"
Someone said: "That's right, no matter what, it would be better to let the disciples use two sets of swords to add to the fun."
King Jian sneered: "No, no, no, what's so good about using embroidered fists and embroidered legs? Since it is a martial arts sect, of course it is a martial arts sect to entertain. Don't you think so, Master Nangong?"
Nangong Xiu had a look of embarrassment on his face: "His Royal Highness King Jian has a body of a thousand pieces of gold, but his sword has no eyes, so I'm afraid something might make a mistake..."
King Jian waved his hand and said: "Head of Nangong is overthinking. What I want is for you, Yunyin Sect, to be the host. For all the guests who are visiting today, host and guest will compete with each other. It will not only enhance friendship, but also add to the fun of the banquet. It can be said to kill two birds with one stone." Princess Chao Yongle blinked: "What do you think, sister, my idea is good, right?"
Princess Yongle snorted and was noncommittal. She was actually bored. King Jian's idea was a good one, but for some reason, she felt that there was something wrong with this proposal coming from the mouth of King Jian, who had always been uninterested in business.
Later, King Jian added: "Of course, this competition is mainly for young disciples, so there is an age limit. Disciples over the age of sixteen will not participate. In addition, since it is a competition, there should be a prize. I announced that the contestants on the winning side will each receive a high-grade small elixir."
As soon as these words came out, the enthusiasm of these young people at the banquet was instantly ignited. A high-grade small elixir can greatly increase spiritual power when taken by low-level warriors. It will also be of great help if used to break through realms.
Regardless of the high-grade elixir, if you can take the opportunity to shine in the competition and attract the attention of the royal family, you can also get a lot of benefits by relying on the relationship with the royal family, and go further in the martial arts. The sect you are currently in can also rely on this relationship to increase your status.
Nangong Xiu was helpless. He didn't know that King Jian deliberately caused trouble for Yunyinmen because of the previous incident. The young disciples who came to visit today are all the proud disciples of each sect, and they are very powerful.
As for the small sect of Yunyin Sect, the spiritual power level of the disciples is generally low. Nangong Yue's qualifications are pretty good, but unfortunately she is a girl. It is obviously inappropriate for a sect to expect a girl to come forward. As for Lu Duofu, he has the best mind and understanding, but it is a pity that he cannot practice...
A tragic defeat today is doomed to be inevitable. Nangong Xiu smiled bitterly and said: "In this case, I will no longer spoil the fun. Everything is left to His Highness's arrangement. However, since it is a discussion, we should stop at the point and don't deliberately hurt others."
Shi Yuanlong, the leader of the Iron Fist Sect, said with a smile: "Brother Nangong is too worried. All the wise nephews here will know how to handle it and will never hurt the disciples of your sect." "That's right, don't worry, Brother Nangong still has to give him face." All the guests said one after another.
He actually didn't take Yunyin Sect seriously at all, and all the disciples of Yunyin Sect cursed secretly. Nangong Xiu's face was expressionless, and he turned to Nangong Yue and said, "Yue'er, you have nothing to do here. You can take Duofu and leave first!"
Nangong Yue hasn’t answered yet, King Jian was the first to speak: "Wait a minute, Master Nangong. Sister Yue'er is a woman, so it's okay not to participate in this competition. But this brother Lu, as a man and your only disciple, how can he stay out of it."
Nangong Xiu's heart trembled. King Jian must be targeting Lu Duofu because of what happened before. He said respectfully, "Your Highness is unaware that Duofu was born without spiritual veins and cannot practice. So, he should not be allowed to participate in this competition, right?"
The guests in the hall were all shocked. They all stared at Lu Duofu with their eyes wide open as if they had discovered a monster. Lu Duofu's scalp was numb from the sight. King Jian was also stunned: "Without spiritual veins, how can a person not have spiritual veins? Head Nangong, are you making a mistake?"
Nangong Xiudao: "I don't dare to deceive Your Highness. My disciple is indeed born with a dead pulse. Everyone in our sect knows this. I also took him to visit famous doctors, but there was no solution."
King Jian said to a guard beside him: "Gan Rong, see if this boy is what the head of Nangong said." The guard named Gan Rong has reached the Wuzong realm, and his spiritual sense is extremely sharp. He immediately released his spiritual sense, glanced at Lu Duofu, and said calmly: "Your Highness, this young man really has no spiritual power."
Lu Duofu breathed a sigh of relief, but also felt strange. He clearly possesses spiritual power, but with the power of this guard, there is no reason why he can't detect it. If he deliberately concealed it, that doesn't make sense. Could it be that I had an illusion in the past, and that what I cultivated in the so-called "boundless sea" was not spiritual power at all? Thinking of this, Lu Duofu felt a little panicked for no reason.
In fact, what Lu Duofu didn't know was that although he had cultivated spiritual power, his level was too low and his spiritual power was too weak to be easily perceived.
Another deeper reason is that it is difficult for people to accurately evaluate things that they are not familiar with. Since the unique operation method of Pulseless Breath is not known to ordinary people, it is not easy for people who practice Pulseless Breath to sense their spiritual power from other warriors.
This is equivalent to Lu Duofu being born with an extra layer of protective color. In the future, as his spiritual power accumulates, he may be seen by others as possessing spiritual power, but they may not be able to see it accurately. For example, if Lu Duofu is currently at the Martial Emperor Realm, others can tell at a glance that he is a warrior, but they cannot tell specifically what level of the Martial Emperor Realm he is.
…
King Jian sighed and said: "So, he is indeed a waste." He was unwilling to accept it. Originally, this competition was mainly aimed at Lu Duofu. He had already thought about it, and once Lu Duofu came on the stage, he would arrange for an opponent with a higher level of cultivation, and then hint that the opponent would beat Lu Duofu hard, or at least cripple him.
There was no way to go now. Lu Duofu had no spiritual power. As a majestic prince, he couldn't force a loser who couldn't practice to compete.
The whole room burst into laughter. "Brother Nangong, what do you think, why do you accept such a disciple?"
"Trash that can't cultivate, haha, I'll kill a hundred of them by myself."
"Being born with no pulse, this is something I have never heard of..."
Nangong Yue's pretty face was furious. When these people laughed at Lu Duofu, they were laughing at her. If there was a chance, she would definitely teach these people a lesson so that Lu Duofu could vent their anger.
